messages:
Anna Lopez: FYI I opened a draft PR that touches dashboards + tracing hooks to add a cost-attribution breakdown and an example showing token_cost in traces. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 - can folks review? cc @Mike @Samir
Mike Chen: taking a look now. quick Q: are we adding a new metric name or reusing existing `request_cost_usd`? would prefer to keep names stable for existing dashboards.
Samir Patel: I skimmed the PR — looks good. small suggestion for SDK snippet: prefer the streaming JS example for latency breakdowns. something like:
```js
const resp = await redwood.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-4',
  prompt: 'summarize',
  stream: true,
});
resp.on('data', (chunk) => { /* update latency chart */ });
// cost fields are available on the final meta: resp.meta.token_cost
```
Jeremy Kim: also noticed the console's dashboard schema changed slightly (metric labels moved under `panels[].metrics[]`). the migration guide should call that out and include a tiny `jq` snippet to transform old JSON to new.
Anna Lopez: good call. I'll add a migration snippet in docs/console/dashboards/migration-to-v2.md and a note in docs/observability/tracing-hooks.md about `token_cost` being added to trace metadata.
Samir Patel: for the tracing example, can we include a sample OTLP span attribute name? e.g. `redwood.token_cost_usd` so platform integrators can map it into their tracing dashboards.
Mike Chen: SGTM. also please add a tiny e2e check in the docs PR to verify the example payload contains `token_cost` so CI will catch regressions.
Anna Lopez: good idea — will add a one-line test under docs/tests/example_tracing_payload.test.js.
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/ (netlify) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deploy preview ready and sandbox available at `sandbox-842.redwood-inference.internal`. use `curl` to fetch the example trace payload: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://sandbox-842/api/trace/example`
Jeremy Kim: for the dashboard copy, small wording nit: change "cost attribution" -> "cost attribution (per route/model)" so it's clearer to customers.
Anna Lopez: done, pushed an update to the PR with the wording change + added the jq migration snippet + the JS streaming SDK snippet + CI check. thanks all. planning to merge tomorrow after one more review. :rocket:
